author: Camemes
body:
You know when you are playing nebula and you are breaking the monument and it only gives you like 1 bar of xp. I believe that the long the game goes on the more xp you receive for kills and breaking monuments. This could also be for the walls, more xp for kills and winning.

So I hope you will agree with me on this descision. The longer the game, the higher the stakes.

Thanks, Sheamus

replies.author: TheTNTPotato
replies.body:
The amount of extra XP shouldn't be ridiculous. Maybe for every 15 minutes, it's an extra 2 XP (higher with donor multipliers), for each monument & win (walls), then 1 for each kill for the walls.

Kills for Nebula should stay the same. Also, if the kills for the walls was to be abused,  to  gain more XP, it could be punishable for XP Farming + Prolonging matches. :)
